law: A component state channel declared at ROOT SCOPE must resolve through the material vocabulary. F-10: 488 hand-authored state channels, material coverage 0 % / 3 % / 92 % across the three artifacts, and one hover meaning ~370 edits. Decrease-only: the baseline follows the tree DOWN, never up.
scope: authored CSS under src/foundation/tokens/css and src/components. Generated artifacts are outputs, and Classic/Rustic are frozen (owner, 2026-09-05), so neither is debt this lane lowers.
exclusions: tone-scoped (name or value reaches a tone ramp), structural (transparent/none/currentColor/inherit/initial/unset), family-governed (--ds-sidebar-* <- navigation.sidebar-tone), governed-alias (a var() to a governed sibling of the same component). Each is a RULE, not an entry: a material root cannot express those values.

ratchets.ungoverned: DECREASE-ONLY. The tree may have fewer ungoverned channels than the pin, never more. Lowering it re-pins; raising it is the failure.
ratchets.ratioFloor: FLOOR, held by hand. governed/population may not fall below it. Provisional and self-pinned (see the gate docblock): it is this lane's number, not F-10's 80 %, which is measured on a different population.
ratchets.populationFloor: FLOOR, and therefore the OPPOSITE direction to `ungoverned`: the measured channel population may not fall below it. Added for audit 100 (F6), which drove the gate green on a tree where every stylesheet survived and every `--ds-` prefix had been renamed away -- population 0, ratio 1, zero failures. A legitimate shrink exists (a family cut that deletes channels instead of arming them), and it re-pins this number under owner review exactly like `corpusFloor`; it never silently passes. A population of zero is named as its own failure even when no baseline pins the floor.
ratchets.corpusFloor: FLOOR, held by hand and deliberately loose (300 against a measured 349). It answers 'is the gate still reading the CSS tree', not 'did one file move'.
ratchets.measuredCorpus: OBSERVATION, not a ratchet. It records what the tree measured when this baseline was written (349 stylesheets, re-measured 2026-09-11; the previous 348 was stale). Nothing fails on it; `corpusFloor` is the clause that bites.
ratchets.population: OBSERVATION of the same run. `populationFloor` is the clause that bites.
ratchets.governed: OBSERVATION. Nothing reads it; the ratio is derived from the tree, not from this number.

honesty: WO-DER-02 took this from 22/134 governed to 122/137. The 15 that remain are measured debt, not an allowlist, and every one of them is enumerated below with the work order that closes it. Three shapes recur: a filled/track variant whose resting ground is not a surface role; a depth channel that belongs to the elevation ladder rather than to a material; and a restatement that aliases a resting sibling which is itself unarmed, so the governed-alias rule cannot rescue it one indirection deep.
dispositionLaw: Each row closes with its family's cut (roadmap/family-cuts.md). `owner` is used when that lane names the family in a cut's own outcome list. Where it does not, the row carries `ownerCandidate` + `gap: true` instead: the nearest cut is named as a proposal and the missing assignment is the finding, because inventing an assignment here would put a channel in a work order that never agreed to own it. Four families are in that state today: slider, float-button, signal-card and command-home.
